mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is active regardless of the broader economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (the 2019 median for the prior 12 months).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market and robust economic growth, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as a 3-month rise in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25 percentage points), the increased cost of capital and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles as defined by FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to the prior 12 months indicates a strong labor market and expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate (HOUST) exceeding 1,200,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and robust demand for residential construction, which increases corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1,200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (from GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion and robust corporate supply capacity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is rising and GDPC1 growth rate is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a high inflation regime (defined as year-over-year CPIAUCSL growth exceeding 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%).
